primary_source_byte_hash_limit: Web-verified original text/PDF and indexed primary records; no external publication bytes archived. No fabricated PDF hashes.
limitations: Authentic published illustrations/formats, not systematically sampled narrative corpus or human-prevalence/sensitivity/specificity measurement.
Model-organization/access is a structural analogy, separate from perceptual appearance and existing manner qualification.
Localization confidence, forced-localization entropy or field concentration does not verify felt clarity/presence.
Faithful source dependence can be explained by shared state estimation and external narration; rival parity limits specificity.
Current pack requires exact software binding and independently preserved first ratings; it does not establish code correctness or rater reliability.
